glosses: branch (woody part of a tree arising from the trunk and usually dividing)

examples.text: Eu tirei um galho da árvore.
examples.en: I cut a branch from the tree.

examples.text: Ele cortou alguns galhos da árvore.
examples.en: He cut some branches off the tree.

examples.text: O menino tentou serrar o galho morto.
examples.en: The boy tried to saw off the dead branch.

examples.text: O gato se escondeu entre os galhos.
examples.en: The cat hid among the branches.
Many birds are on the branch.
